message.reasoning_content:
Verify only that line changed. Use a shell diff against a reconstructed original? I can use python to compare. Let me check git status too. Actually simplest: reconstruct original from known content and diff. Let me run a shell command that verifies sections.

I'll write original to a temp file and diff. In approved_scope bwrap temp files end with call, that's fine.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "cd \"$(pwd)\" && printf '[dev]\\nhost = dev.internal\\nretries = 3\\n\\n[staging]\\nhost = staging.internal\\nretries = 3\\ntimeout = 30\\n\\n[prod]\\nhost = prod.internal\\nretries = 3\\ntimeout = 60\\n' > /tmp/orig.ini && diff -u /tmp/orig.ini app.ini; echo \"exit=$?\"; git diff --no-color -- app.ini 2>/dev/null || true"}
